data.title: Corgan and University of Arkansas Research Explores How Workplace Design Influences Attention and Focus
data.description: Corgan, an architecture and design company based in Dallas, has recently published award-winning research focusing on neurodiversity, ADHD, and workplace design. The study aims to enhance focus and overall well-being in the workplace environment.

data.title: Lorient Opens New York Office, Expanding U.S. Footprint
data.description: Lorient, a healthcare-oriented investment firm managing around $2 billion in assets, revealed the launch of its latest office in New York City, marking its expansion in the U.S. With the new Midtown East location, it becomes Lorient’s third office in the country, alongside sites in Birmingham, Michigan, and Miami, Florida. The New York office will commence operations with six professionals on board, boosting the firm's team and investment capabilities.

data.title: LNL Capital Appoints Joel Tomlinson as Managing Partner to Oversee Net Lease Capital Strategy
data.description: In New York, LNL Capital, a net lease capital platform, has named Joel Tomlinson as Managing Partner to develop the Company's structured debt and equity strategy in the single-tenant retail, industrial, and healthcare net lease sectors. With this appointment, LNL Capital aims to expand its presence in these markets by leveraging Tomlinson's extensive experience. Tomlinson's expertise spans across the triple net retail sector, focusing on sale-leasebacks and recognizing value-add and opportunistic transactions. This strategic move signifies the Company's commitment to growth and innovation in these areas.

data.title: Masco Corporation Appoints Yaron Ben David as Chief Technology and AI Officer
data.description: Masco Corporation (NYSE: MAS) headquartered in Livonia, Michigan, disclosed the hiring of Yaron Ben David as the Chief Technology and AI Officer, effective from September 15, 2026. Ben David, appointed to the position by President and CEO Jon Nudi, will join Masco’s Executive Committee. This role has been newly established to reinforce Masco’s commitment to enhancing capabilities that drive growth, innovation, and value across its array of renowned brands.

data.title: Newsweek Names LP Building Solutions One of America’s Greatest Companies
data.description: LP Building Solutions, based in Nashville, Tennessee, has recently been recognized as one of America’s top companies for the year 2026 by Newsweek. This prestigious honor underscores the company's excellence and success in the industry.

data.title: Sagard Real Estate Expands Fulton Industrial Presence with Atlanta Acquisition
data.description: Atlanta's Sagard Real Estate, a top real estate investment advisor under Sagard, an asset management firm, has purchased 5070 Phillip Lee Drive SW in Atlanta. This industrial property spans 400,800 square feet in the Fulton Industrial area. The acquisition was done for Sagard Real Estate's open-end core-plus real estate fund. The property includes four connected warehouse buildings.

data.title: Mastercard Dreamonomics Research Finds U.S. Small Businesses Are Prioritizing Predictable Growth, With the TCS New York City Marathon Showing the Opportunity Major Moments Can Create
data.description: In the latest North America report by Mastercard's Dreamonomics research, it is revealed that small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) are adapting to a challenging economy by focusing on stability, readiness, and resilience rather than rapid growth. This shift in priorities highlights a trend seen in the global Dreamonomics report, indicating that entrepreneurs are now seeking growth that is secure, safeguarded, and more manageable. The research emphasizes the importance of predictable and protected growth for businesses.

data.title: Mastercard’s Dreamonomics Report Finds Small Business Owners Are Redefining Growth for a More Demanding Economy: 68% Prioritize Stability Over Speed, 89% Want More Digital Tools and 71% Say Cyber Protection Is a Priority
data.description: In Purchase, N.Y., Mastercard has unveiled Dreamonomics, a fresh global perspective on how small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are adapting to new market conditions. According to the report, SMEs are focused on a strategy of steady progress, with 68% emphasizing stability and predictability over rapid expansion. Additionally, 54% are actively steering clear of unnecessary financial risks. This study reflects the cautious yet ambitious mindset of SMEs as they navigate the evolving business landscape.
